title: Steepleaf
lead: A thoughtful tea companion — catalog, brew journal, flavor notes, and discovery without social ranking.
mission: Help people explore tea with curiosity and sensory attention: what you brew, how it tastes, and what you want to try next.
principles: No influencer rankings or follower counts
Brew notes are private by default

modules.title: Tea catalog
modules.description: Tea entries with origin, type, and tasting vocabulary.

modules.title: Brew journal
modules.description: Local brew sessions: leaf, water, time, temperature, and notes.

modules.title: Collections
modules.description: Private shelves and tasting sets via shared platform collections.

modules.title: Brew timer architecture
modules.description: Timer hooks tied to brew journal entries.

dataModel: TeaEntry and BrewSession models store locally. Platform Collections and Profile integrate across apps. No marketplace layer.
